votes.motion: MOVED TO APPROVE THE MINUTES AS AMENDED. MOTION WAS SECONDED BY COUNCIL MEMBER BLAIR,
MOVED TO REMOVE PROPOSED RESOLUTION 2025-23 FROM THE CONSENT AGENDA. MOTION WAS SECONDED BY COUNCIL MEMBER CHOBERKA,

MOVED TO AMEND RESOLUTION 2025-23 BY STRIKING THE THIRD "WHEREAS" CLAUSE THAT STATED, "WHEREAS THE MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF THE OGDEN CITY COUNCIL, THROUGH PUBLIC ENGAGEMENT, DETERMINED THERE IS A STRONG COMMUNITY SUPPORT IN MAINTAINING THE PROPERTY FOR OPEN SPACE." COUNCIL MEMBER CHOBERKA SECONDED THE MOTION.

ON A MOTION BY VICE CHAIR HYER AND SECONDED BY COUNCIL MEMBER GRAF, AMENDED RESOLUTION 2025-23 WAS ADOPTED [ENTITLED: "A resolution of the Ogden City Council declaring the intent of Ogden City to purchase surplus property from the Ogden School District."]

MOVED THE MEETING ADJOURN AT 10:23 P.M. MOTION WAS SECONDED BY VICE CHAIR HYER,
